data.name: Settings.About.Tagline
data.value: A Genshin Impact / Zenless Zone Zero launcher for Linux

data.name: Settings.About.ReplicaNote
data.value: LunarWard is a Linux reimplementation of Starward; the layout is replicated from Starward (MIT). Launching, runtimes and environment handling are rewritten for Linux.

data.name: Settings.About.License
data.value: Released under the MIT license. Starward is copyright Scighost.

data.name: Settings.About.Thanks
data.value: Thanks to Starward (Scighost) for the UI structure and Core API, to an-anime-team for the wine component index, and to the official HoYoPlay asset API for backgrounds and notices.

data.name: Settings.General.LanguageDesc
data.value: UI language. Takes effect immediately and is written to config.json.

data.name: Settings.General.ThemeDesc
data.value: Starward follows the Windows light/dark setting; LunarWard is dark only, matching Starward's fallback colour, and does not follow the desktop theme.

data.name: Settings.General.LaunchBehaviorValue
data.value: Return to the last used game profile

data.name: Settings.General.LaunchBehaviorDesc
data.value: Backed by launcher.last_profile_index in config.json; shown read-only.

data.name: Settings.General.CloseDesc
data.value: What closing the main window does: hide to tray keeps background timing/updates running; exit completely ends the process.

data.name: Settings.General.TrayHint
data.value: Minimize to tray needs a StatusNotifier host (KDE has it by default; GNOME needs the AppIndicator extension). With Exit selected, closing the window ends the process.

data.name: Settings.General.Autostart
data.value: Start automatically at login (minimized to tray)

data.name: Settings.General.AutostartHint
data.value: Writes $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/autostart/lunarward.desktop with --start-hidden, so LunarWard waits in the system tray after login. Deleting that file is the same as turning this switch off.

data.name: Settings.General.AnnouncementsDesc
data.value: The card in the lower-left corner of the launcher page (banner plus events / notices / news).

data.name: Settings.General.VideoBackgroundDesc
data.value: A video in the background folder wins over a still image; without libvlc it falls back to the image.

data.name: Settings.General.PendingEffect
data.value: These two toggles are written to config.json, but the launcher page does not read them yet, so switching has no immediate effect.

data.name: Settings.Download.RetriesValue
data.value: 3 for transient HTTP errors / 5 in the install pipeline

data.name: Settings.Download.ReadOnlyNote
data.value: Concurrency, timeout and retries in LunarWard.Installer are constants in code (matching upstream Starward.RPC); there is no writable setting. The defaults are shown as they are, with no fake input boxes.

data.name: Settings.Download.ComponentSourceDesc
data.value: Index URL and local index state for wine / dxvk components. The index is cached under components/ in the data folder.

data.name: Settings.Files.ClearCacheDesc
data.value: Deletes everything under the cache folder except today's logs; the folder structure is recreated afterwards.

data.name: Settings.Files.ClearCacheBody
data.value: This deletes the cached content under {0} (today's logs are kept). It cannot be undone. Continue?

data.name: Settings.Screenshot.Desc
data.value: Screenshots are written by the game: Genshin / Zenless use <game>/ScreenShot, Star Rail uses StarRail_Data/ScreenShots.

data.name: Settings.Screenshot.FormatValue
data.value: Chosen by the game (PNG / JPG / WebP)

data.name: Settings.Screenshot.FormatDesc
data.value: LunarWard never rewrites game screenshots: no transcoding, no renaming, no EXIF changes.

data.name: Settings.Screenshot.SortDesc
data.value: The list is always sorted by modification time, newest first; there is no other ordering.

data.name: Settings.Screenshot.WicNote
data.value: Starward uses WIC on Windows to transcode screenshots to AVIF / JPEG XL. Linux has no equivalent system transcoder and needs none — this page only discovers, previews and exports.

data.name: Settings.Download.HardLinkDesc

data.name: Settings.Download.HardLinkUnavailable
data.value: The installer backend supports hard links, but this global switch is not wired up yet; each install follows the dialog's note and the actual behaviour.

data.name: Settings.Download.SpeedLimitDesc
data.value: The number 0 means no speed limit.

data.name: Settings.Download.SpeedLimitUnavailable
data.value: LunarWard.Installer has no rate limiter; the number box keeps its Starward position and is disabled.

data.name: Settings.Files.DataFolderImportant
data.value: Your personal data is stored in the folder below. It is very important, please do not delete it casually.

data.name: Settings.Files.ReselectUnavailable
data.value: On Linux the data folder is decided by XDG_CONFIG_HOME / XDG_DATA_HOME (defaults ~/.config, ~/.local/share) and cannot be changed here.

data.name: Settings.Files.BackupUnavailable
data.value: Backup writes a consistent snapshot of LunarWardDatabase.db (gacha, accounts, playtime, Genshin Beyond) to the chosen path; game files are not included.

data.name: Settings.Files.BackupDatabaseHint
data.value: Back up the local database into one .db file (SQLite VACUUM INTO, WAL merged)

data.name: Settings.Files.DeleteAllUnavailable
data.value: One-click deletion of all settings is not offered (too easy to lose data); clean the config folder manually under "Folders and files".

data.name: Settings.Screenshot.BuiltinFolderDesc
data.value: The built-in screenshot feature will save images to the following folder.

data.name: Settings.Screenshot.GameDecides
data.value: Decided by the game (PNG / JPG / WebP)

data.name: Settings.Screenshot.FormatUnavailable
data.value: Starward uses WIC to transcode to AVIF / JPEG XL (PNG/AVIF/JPEG XL × Medium/High/Lossless); Linux has no equivalent system transcoder and LunarWard does not rewrite screenshots, so this row keeps its position but is unavailable.

data.name: Settings.Screenshot.HdrNote
data.value: When capturing HDR images, SDR version will also be saved.

data.name: Settings.Screenshot.CaptureButtonsUnavailable
data.value: Starward's "Test Screenshot / Clear Thumbnail Cache" depend on its own capture pipeline; LunarWard does not take over screenshots, so both buttons keep their positions but are disabled.

data.name: Settings.Screenshot.NoChangeFolder
data.value: The screenshot folder is decided by the game (Genshin / Zenless: <game>/ScreenShot, Star Rail: StarRail_Data/ScreenShots) and cannot be changed by the launcher.

data.name: Settings.Screenshot.FeatureDesc
data.value: Starward's screenshot feature captures the running game (with limits such as minimized windows or off-screen areas); LunarWard does not capture the game: images are written by the game itself, and this page only counts them and opens the folder.

data.name: Settings.Screenshot.GamepadSuggestion
data.value: Controller screenshots need button mapping on the Controller Enhancement page; LunarWard does not support controller enhancement, so use Steam Input or your compositor's mapping.

data.name: Settings.Hotkey.SingleKeyTips
data.value: Linux has no cross-desktop global hotkey API: the F1–F12 single-key shortcuts Starward registers with RegisterHotKey are not available here (see the end of this page for alternatives).

data.name: Settings.Hotkey.HotkeyUnavailable
data.value: This box is Starward's HotkeyInput; Linux has no equivalent global hotkey API, so the control keeps its position but is disabled.

data.name: Settings.Advanced.RpcDesc
data.value: Starward's RPC service is a separate process that avoids restarts for features needing administrator rights (game downloads, updates). LunarWard has no RPC process and needs no administrator rights.

data.name: Settings.Advanced.RpcNotRunning
data.value: RPC Service is not running (LunarWard does not provide this service)

data.name: Settings.Advanced.RpcUnavailableNote
data.value: This keeps Starward's status-row position: there are no "Run Service / Stop Service" buttons because the service does not exist.

data.name: Settings.Gamepad.XboxOnly
data.value: Only Xbox protocol controllers are supported. Compatibility with other types of controllers is not guaranteed.

data.name: Settings.Gamepad.Unavailable
data.value: There is no GameInput component on Linux; controller enhancement is unavailable.

data.name: Settings.Gamepad.SimulateInputDesc
data.value: Simulate keyboard and mouse input using a game controller. Starward needs administrator rights; LunarWard has no equivalent key injection, so the switch keeps its position but is disabled.

data.name: Settings.Gamepad.LongPressGuide
data.value: Press and hold the Guide button to open the Starward main window.

data.name: Settings.Gamepad.BothThumbsticks
